summary: CR-047 Category-Scoped Forward Push - All features verified and working correctly. Store Management page loads with two outlets showing category badges (palmbharat 2/36, palmruby 36/36). Push button opens CategoryPushDialog (NOT direct push). Dialog shows Previously Pushed section with pre-selected categories and synced badges, Not Yet Pushed section with new badges. Resolution Preview auto-updates on category selection. Push button shows 'Push N Categories' and is disabled when 0 selected. Select All/None buttons work. Category search filters list. Push execution shows results with inserted/updated counts per module. Done button closes dialog and refreshes store list.

store_management_page_loads.evidence: Page loads with data-testid='store-management', shows 2 stores in hierarchy

category_badges_display.evidence: palmbharat (815) shows '2/36 categories' badge, palmruby (814) shows '36/36 categories' badge via data-testid='cat-badge-{childId}'

push_button_opens_dialog.evidence: Clicking Push button on store row opens CategoryPushDialog with data-testid='category-push-dialog' (NOT a direct push)

previously_pushed_section.evidence: Dialog shows 'Previously Pushed' section with COFFEE and Cake Cabinet pre-selected with 'synced' badges for palmbharat

not_yet_pushed_section.evidence: Dialog shows 'Not Yet Pushed' section with unchecked categories with 'new' badges (34 new categories for palmbharat)

resolution_preview_auto_updates.evidence: Resolution Preview panel with data-testid='push-preview' shows resolved_counts (Categories, Products, Addons, Recipes, Sub-Recipes, Ingredients, Stock Categories, Stock Items) and updates when categories are toggled

push_button_disabled_when_none_selected.evidence: After clicking 'None' button, push button shows 'Push 0 Categories' and is disabled (is_disabled: True)

select_all_none_buttons.evidence: Select All (data-testid='select-all-cats') selects all 36 categories, None (data-testid='deselect-all-cats') deselects all

category_search.evidence: Search input (data-testid='cat-search') filters category list - searching 'COFFEE' shows only 1 row

push_execution_shows_results.evidence: Push with 2 categories completed successfully. Results panel (data-testid='push-results') shows: Categories 2 upd, Products 63 upd, Addons 7 upd, Recipes 4 upd, Ingredients 8 upd, Stock Categories 3 upd

done_button_closes_dialog.evidence: Done button (data-testid='push-done-btn') closes dialog and refreshes store list. Toast shows 'Push complete — 2 categories synced'

fully_synced_store_dialog.evidence: palmruby (814) with 36/36 categories: dialog shows all 36 pre-selected, only 'Previously Pushed' section visible, 37 synced badges, 0 new badges

context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-047 Category-Scoped Forward Push is fully implemented and working. All 10 features from the review request have been verified: (1) Store Management page with category badges, (2) Push button opens CategoryPushDialog, (3) Previously Pushed section with pre-selected categories and synced badges, (4) Not Yet Pushed section with new badges, (5) Resolution Preview auto-updates, (6) Push button disabled when no categories selected, (7) Select All/None buttons, (8) Category search, (9) Push results with inserted/updated counts, (10) Done button closes dialog and refreshes list. The push operation takes ~30s to complete. Backend proxy to preprod.mygenie.online is working correctly.
